meta.title: next-query docs
meta.description: Tag your native fetch, revalidate it by tag in the Next.js App Router, and see every tagged fetch in a dev panel.

index.title: Introduction
index.description: What next-query is, what you get and when to use it.

getting-started.title: Getting started
getting-started.description: Install the package, tag a fetch, revalidate it and open the panel.

query.title: query
query.description: Cache data that isn't fetch (an ORM, an SDK) under a key, with the same tags.

revalidate.title: revalidate
revalidate.description: Revalidate a tag, or a query key, from server actions and route handlers.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Plain cache tags, the tags() hierarchy, escaping and limits.

panel.title: The panel
panel.description: The dev panel: tagged fetches and queries, freshness bars, revalidating and the data of each entry.

compatibility.title: Compatibility
compatibility.description: What works on Next.js 15 and 16, and what runs where.

security.title: Security
security.description: What the dev panel exposes, and why it does nothing outside development.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting & FAQ
troubleshooting.description: Known limitations and fixes for common problems.

contributing.title: Contributing
contributing.description: Monorepo layout, the playground, tests, these docs and releasing.
